_comment: App-defined standard columns beyond PaperDataTemplate (which is never modified). Written after the template's 280 columns, only when filled. Part of the bundled base variable list (registry.py).

columns.description: Wet-dry cycling: temperature during the wet (hydrated / humid) phase

Wet-dry cycling: relative humidity during the wet phase
Wet-dry cycling: temperature during the dry (dehydration) phase
